preregistered_experiments.description: Full H86I-SACD: multi-resolution native + SHA-pinned USGS 1 m LiDAR / 10 m 3DEP / fluvial chi / GeoDAWN K-Th-U & TMI_up150 static physics + fold-visible Pollard-Segall elastic tip fields + Spin-2 Coulomb-projected strike concordance (LiDAR/10 m scarp, Laplace g_zz, Verduzco magnetic tilt) + Bekker-Davis label-free alluvial-burial propensity PU weighting + Minoux 300 m triangular-kernel submodular expected-TP_w dot allocation.

Matched-collar ablation removing Spin-2 strike-director concordance, removing Bekker-Davis alluvial-burial propensity weighting, and replacing 300 m submodular kernel allocation with standard pointwise disc_thin(spacing=2.8) at identical 37,654-dot budget and 3.0-px collar.

Pure cover-blind subsurface + hydrothermal alteration + Spin-2 subsurface strike concordance (zero DEM/slope/LiDAR/10 m topo/fluvial chi surface scarps) with Bekker-Davis propensity and 300 m submodular kernel allocation at 37,654 dots and 3.0-px collar.

registry_and_export_gates.surface_before_placement: scripts/check_h86e_registry.py --surface must confirm 0 Spearman rho > 0.90 firings across all valid competition-grid registry rasters before dot placement.
registry_and_export_gates.dots_before_serialization: scripts/check_h86e_registry.py and scripts/pa86_chance_overlap.py must confirm byte_unique=True, pixel_unique=True, 0 Spearman rho > 0.90 firings, and 0 discrete non-space-filling (halo <= 0.70) 3-px overlap > 0.70 firings before GeoTIFF serialization.
registry_and_export_gates.fail_closed_submission_policy: Because 17GEMSDOE covers 100.0% of allowed footprint pixels and 2 indexed upstream registry rows (14GEMSDOE, 7GEMSDOE) are off-grid, literal_gate_pass and registry_complete_for_index remain False; verdict MUST be recorded as 'negative', decision 'DO NOT SUBMIT', safe_to_submit=False, approved_for_weekly_slot=False, submission_slots_used=0.
